scripts.local:check-user: test "$(id -u)" -ne 0 || (echo '错误：不要使用 sudo/root 运行本地项目命令。' >&2; exit 1)
scripts.local:up: docker compose up -d --wait postgres redis qdrant
scripts.local:down: docker compose stop postgres redis qdrant
scripts.local:start: pnpm local:up && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm dev
scripts.dev: pnpm local:check-user && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && turbo run dev
scripts.dev:server: pnpm local:check-user && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && pnpm --filter @supportly/server dev
scripts.dev:admin: pnpm local:check-user && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && pnpm --filter @supportly/admin dev
scripts.dev:support: pnpm local:check-user && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && pnpm --filter @supportly/support dev
scripts.db:check: pnpm local:check-user && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && pg_isready -d "$DATABASE_URL" && redis-cli -u "$REDIS_URL" ping
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm local:check-user && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && pnpm --filter @supportly/server migrate
scripts.admin:create: pnpm local:check-user && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && pnpm --filter @supportly/server admin:create --
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && turbo run lint typecheck test
